summary: TriNet Group filed a routine 8-K on September 14, 2026, disclosing that its Board declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.29 per share of common stock on September 11, 2026. Record and ex-dividend dates are October 1, 2026, with payment on October 26, 2026. The filing includes a press release as Exhibit 99.1 and standard Item 9.01 exhibits; no advisor, premium, stake, or transaction mechanics are stated. This is an ordinary capital-return announcement, not a special situation; watch only for any future shift in dividend policy or payout cadence.
